WITH SalesByWarehouse AS (
    SELECT 仓库名称,
           SUM(CASE WHEN 开单金额 IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(开单金额 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) ELSE 0 END) AS 销售出库金额
    FROM dbo.inout
    WHERE 单据类型 LIKE '%销售%'
      AND YEAR(按日期) = YEAR(GETDATE())
    GROUP BY 仓库名称
), Total AS (
    SELECT SUM(销售出库金额) AS 总销售出库金额
    FROM SalesByWarehouse
)
SELECT 仓库名称,
       ົ销售出库金额 AS 销售出库金额,
       CAST(100.0 * 销售出库金额 / NULLIF(总销售出库金额, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS 占比百分比
FROM SalesByWarehouse
CROSS JOIN Total
ORDER BY 占比百分比 DESC
